clips.text: I received your letter when I got back I could feel the ardor of your heart through your words.
I well know the fervor that stirs your soul and the thirst that turns into tears within you.
I was once there too, I too have suffered it.
I can well understand your heart because I have traveled those same paths you now have to take in the quest for God.
I too have experienced the longing that one day turns into a raging fire in which one has to consume oneself.
But this burning brings the birth of a new life.
The drop can only become the ocean when it ceases to exist.
Continue your efforts in meditation; you have to go deeper and deeper into it - it is the only way.
